subject: general
question: A right circular cone is surmounted on a hemisphere. Base radius of the cone is equal to radius of the hemisphere. The diameter of the hemisphere is 12 cm while the height of the cone is 8 cm. Find the cost of painting the compound object if it costs ₹25 to paint π cm².
solution:
Given:

A right circular cone is surmounted on a hemisphere. Base radius of the cone is equal to radius of the hemisphere.

The diameter of the hemisphere is 12 cm while the height of the cone is 8 cm. 

Concept used:

Slant height = sqrt{Radius² + Height²}

Curved surface area of a sphere = 4π (Radius)²

Curved surface area of a cone = π × Radius × Slant Height

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2f87fe3f2ccdd4f0dbd5516ee2332c9879296b63de82ea5383e008c70143163.png] 

Radius = 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm

Since the right circular cone is surmounted on a hemisphere, the** area of the base = 2π × 6² = 72π cm²**

Slant Height = sqrt{6² + 8²} = 10 cm

Hence, the total surface area of the cone surmounted on the hemisphere

⇒ Curved surface area of the cone + area of the base

⇒ π × 6 × 10 + 72π

⇒ 132π 

Thus, the cost of painting the compound object = (25 × 132π) ÷ π = ₹3300

**∴ The cost of painting the compound object is ₹3300.**

2e
